products.notes: Retailer listing: 4V preamp, 3 sets of RCA preouts incl. subwoofer, digital time alignment control, HPF/LPF (ranges not stated), 3-band parametric Beat EQ.

PASmag bench test (independent measurement): pre-out output impedance 274 ohms, maximum usable pre-out voltage 1.9 V (volume step at which it was reached not reported, so cleanVolumeStep omitted; treat 1.9 V as measured clean max, not the rating). Built-in amp measured 19.1 W/ch (rated 22 W CEA-2006A), 0.07% THD at 1 W. DSP EQ with 3 selectable frequencies each for bass/mid/treble, adjustable Q, +/-15 steps; adjustable HPF/LPF.
Retailer listing (seen via search snippet, page not fully read): '3 Sets of 4V Preamp Outputs' (front, rear, sub). Discontinued.
